data.one_liner: Create realistic liquid glass droplet effects with GPU-accelerated shaders in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that provides GPU-accelerated fragment shader widgets to render liquid glass droplet effects with refraction, blur, lighting, and color tinting. It features individual custom colors for droplets inside a group and supports scrollable widgets and modal routes.
use_when: You want to add realistic liquid glass droplet effects to your UI.
Your target platforms support the Impeller engine.
You need customizable refraction, blur, and lighting highlights on custom shapes.
avoid_when: Your target platforms do not support the Impeller engine.
You need to group more than 4 liquid glass shapes within a single group.
strengths: Pure Flutter implementation with zero external dependencies.
GPU-accelerated fragment shaders for smooth performance.
Highly customizable visual parameters including refraction, blur, and specular highlights.
weaknesses: Works only on platforms that support the Impeller engine.
Grouped shapes are limited to 4 shapes within one group.
Performance degrades with a high quantity of droplet effects.
data.setup_notes: Works only on platforms that support the Impeller engine. Ensure your app targets compatible environments.
data.minimal_example:
OCLiquidGlassGroup(
  settings: const OCLiquidGlassSettings(),
  child: Stack(
    children: [
      Positioned(
        top: 100,
        left: 50,
        child: OCLiquidGlass(
          width: 120,
          height: 80,
          borderRadius: 40,
          child: Container(),
        ),
      ),
    ],
  ),
)
